evals.prompt:
Start Angular upgrade.

base version 20
target version 21
preview url http://localhost:8080/SearchWidgetScenarios/#/LiveForm_Autocomplete
comparison url https://stage-platform.wavemaker.ai/run-jlqb2h631c/SearchWidgetScenarios_master/#/Main
skip preview no
skip tests no
skip verify no
evals.expected_output: Step 0 prints effective config table (Angular 20→21, both repo paths, branches), sets Inputs confirmed: yes in current-state.md after user confirms, and does NOT proceed to Step 1 until the user types 'confirm'.

assertions.name: config-table-printed
assertions.description: Step 0 prints the effective config table showing Angular 20→21, preview URL, comparison URL, skip flags, and both repo paths

assertions.name: waits-for-confirm
assertions.description: Step 0 does not start Step 1 or take any action before receiving 'confirm' from the user

assertions.name: current-state-initialized
assertions.description: After confirmation, current-state.md records ng-runtime branch, ng-codegen path, ng-codegen branch, and Inputs confirmed: yes

assertions.name: branch-mismatch-blocks
assertions.description: If ng-runtime and ng-codegen are on different branches, Step 0 blocks and asks the user to align branches before proceeding

evals.expected_output: Reads current-state.md to find the first step that is not 'done', prints the progress banner for that step, and resumes from there without resetting state or asking for confirmation again.

assertions.name: reads-current-state
assertions.description: Reads current-state.md to determine the current step, rather than starting from Step 0

assertions.name: resumes-from-first-incomplete-step
assertions.description: Starts at the first step that is not marked 'done' in current-state.md

assertions.name: no-state-reset
assertions.description: Does not run scripts/reset-state.sh or overwrite current-state.md when the user says Resume (not Start)

assertions.name: progress-banner-shown
assertions.description: Prints the step start progress banner for the resumed step (format: ━━━ ▶ Step N/10 — Name ━━━)

evals.prompt:
Start Angular upgrade.

base version 20
target version 21
skip preview yes
skip tests no
evals.expected_output: Step 9 is skipped when skip preview is yes. Step 10 still runs. Upgrade doc records that preview was skipped. Step 8 (unit tests) still runs since skip tests is no.

assertions.name: step-9-skipped
assertions.description: When skip preview is yes, Step 9 is recorded as skipped in current-state.md with reason, and the skill does not attempt to open any URLs or deploy to Tomcat

assertions.name: step-8-still-runs
assertions.description: When skip tests is no, Step 8 runs TEST_CMD even though preview is skipped

assertions.name: step-10-documents-skip
assertions.description: Step 10 upgrade doc notes that preview validation was skipped

assertions.name: compatible-changes-only
assertions.description: No signals, inject() style changes, zoneless, or input()/output() modernization applied — only breaking-change fixes
